publication.title: CellPyLib: A Python Library for working with Cellular Automata

derived_evidence: Supports 1D and 2D k-color cellular automata on regular grids.
Provides elementary CA/NKS rules, adjustable neighborhoods, tests, entropy/complexity measures, and PyPI installation.

candidate_claims.claim: CellPyLib provides tested Python implementations of elementary and 2D cellular automata plus complexity measures.
This is the strongest external CA reference for the MVP, but the competition-critical 256-rule generator should remain a small in-repo deterministic kernel for replayability.

derived_evidence: Represents Minesweeper hidden-cell states as Boolean variables.

Distinguishes guaranteed safe, guaranteed mine, and unresolved cells.

candidate_claims.claim: The solver uses SAT constraints over hidden Minesweeper cell states to infer guaranteed safe/mined cells.
This is more relevant to Vithia-Space than a browser game because its constraint representation maps directly onto the proposed hidden-hazard lattice.
